format_row_numpy: format a single row from a PyArrow table into a numpy-compatible mapping using NumpyFormatter
format_column_numpy: format a column from a PyArrow table into a consolidated numpy array using NumpyFormatter
format_batch_numpy: format a batch from a PyArrow table into a mapping of consolidated numpy arrays
recursive_tensorize: recursively convert nested data structures including torch tensors and PIL images to numpy arrays
consolidate_numpy_arrays: consolidate a list of same-shaped numpy arrays into a stacked array or object array
